message.content: {"quality": false, "reason": "The candidate proposes a workflow that relies on the 'chest_xray_report_generator' to corroborate spinal curvature direction when visual assessment is ambiguous. However, the source trajectory evidence explicitly shows that for this specific image (a lateral view), the report generator returned 'no acute cardiopulmonary process' and was silent on scoliosis. Consequently, the model could not use the report to resolve the ambiguity and was forced to rely on a third tool ('llava_med_qa') which hallucinated or correctly identified the finding despite the report's silence. A skill defined by 'report corroboration' is functionally invalid for this case because the report does not contain the necessary information. Furthermore, determining left/right scoliosis convexity from a single lateral projection is clinically unreliable without an AP/PA view; the candidate's logic assumes the report will solve a geometric limitation that the report itself failed to address.", "duplicate_of": null}
